title: Shepler's Mackinac Island Ferry
specs: Mighty Mac departures travel under the Mackinac Bridge with narration and photo opportunities
Passengers of all ages require a ticket; children under 5 travel free but must be accompanied by an adult
Only trained service animals permitted; pets not allowed on scheduled cruises
E-bikes require special approval and forms; prohibited on Mackinac Island except exceptions
Valid military ID required for military discount tickets purchased in person
Complimentary shuttle service between docks, parking lots, and nearby lodging within 1.5 miles (Mackinaw City) or 3 miles (St. Ignace)
includes: Assistance loading and unloading bikes at boarding
Restrooms available at docks; portable restrooms on Lighthouse and Night Sky cruises
Concession stand with pop and water on cruises; bar service on select cruises
gap: Exact age minimum for infants not stated
blurb: Shepler's offers scheduled ferry cruises between Mackinaw City and St. Ignace to Mackinac Island, including special cruises such as Lighthouse and Mighty Mac departures. Passengers of all ages require tickets, and the ferry ride duration varies from 16 to 26 minutes depending on the route.
extraNote: All ferry tickets are non-refundable except scheduled cruises refundable up to 48 hours prior · $2 booking fee per ferry ticket applies to all purchases · Cruises may operate in inclement weather; direction and duration subject to captain's discretion · Smoking not permitted on any vessel; no outside beverages including alcohol allowed onboard · Shepler’s reserves right to cancel cruises due to weather or low ticket sales with full refund · All paid parking is non-refundable · Shepler’s Mackinaw City Dock, 556 E. Central Avenue, Mackinaw City, MI 49701 · April 21 through October 31, 2026
